author: lactify
body:
The current rotation is great, however, it does start to get a tad but boring/repetitive playing the same maps over and over. I understand some were removed, but maps like Clearmont I and Curabitur? 

What at happened to those maps? Removed, or just not added yet?

I hope to see them soon..

title: Adding more DTM Maps?

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
removed

We always accept map submissions if you are interested in creating maps for a gamemode.

Any map that was pre-atlas that isn't currently in rotations was probably removed during reassessment when translating to XML
